column1: Together, these developments have had a profound impact, as demonstrated by these data. Although the increase in women’s labor-force participation is easily explained, the fall in men’s participation may seem puzzling. There are several developments at work. First, young men now stay in school longer than their fathers and grandfathers did. Second, older men now retire earlier and live longer. Third, with more women employed, more fathers now stay at home to raise their children. Full-time students, retirees, and stay-at-home fathers are all counted as out of the labor force.
